title: List the names of leagues whose total goals (home plus away) in the 2015/20
question: List the names of leagues whose total goals (home plus away) in the 2015/2016 season are below the average total goals of all leagues in that same season, ordered by total goals in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH LeagueGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        L."XCL_005" AS LeagueName,
        SUM(M."XCL_015") + SUM(M."XCL_016") AS TotalGoals
    FROM League L
    INNER JOIN Match M ON L."XCL_003" = M."XCL_008"
    WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY L."XCL_005"
),
AvgGoals AS (
    SELECT AVG(TotalGoals) AS AvgTotalGoals
    FROM LeagueGoals
)
SELECT 
    LG.LeagueName
FROM LeagueGoals LG
CROSS JOIN AvgGoals AG
WHERE LG.TotalGoals < AG.AvgTotalGoals
ORDER BY LG.TotalGoals DESC

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH LeagueGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        L."XCL_005" AS LeagueName,
        SUM(M."XCL_015") + SUM(M."XCL_016") AS TotalGoals
    FROM League L
    INNER JOIN Match M ON L."XCL_003" = M."XCL_008"
    WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY L."XCL_005"
),
AvgGoals AS (
    SELECT AVG(TotalGoals) AS AvgTotalGoals
    FROM LeagueGoals
)
SELECT 
    LG.LeagueName
FROM LeagueGoals LG
CROSS JOIN AvgGoals AG
WHERE LG.TotalGoals < AG.AvgTotalGoals
ORDER BY LG.TotalGoals DESC
